issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 09 selects the column 'kreis' and computes AVG(einwohner_m), AVG(einwohner_w) but groups by 'regierungsbezirk' (solution_repository/aufgabe09.sql lines 1-4). The problem text asks for averages per Landkreis (kreis). Grouping by regierungsbezirk while selecting kreis is inconsistent and will cause a SQL grouping error or produce incorrect aggregation results. This contradicts the problem requirement to compute averages per Landkreis.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution to group by 'kreis' (the Landkreis) instead of 'regierungsbezirk'. For example: SELECT kreis, AVG(einwohner_m), AVG(einwohner_w) FROM Gemeinde WHERE flaeche > 100 GROUP BY kreis. Ensure the GROUP BY matches the non-aggregated column(s) required by the task.
